title: Onboard calypso-mini-2b v1.0: perf profiles + metadata + automate changelog
author: Jordan Liu
description:
Context: Add Calypso (calypso-mini-2b v1.0) to the model registry with curated metadata and performance profiles, and hook it into the automated changelog/release notes pipeline. Motivation: customers running small, low-latency models requested an officially supported 2B variant for on-prem and dedicated deployments. This PR registers the model, adds perf profiles for common sequence lengths, and extends the changelog automation to include model onboarding events.

What this PR does: 
- Adds model metadata (tags, tokenizer, FLAVOR, supported runtimes) for calypso-mini-2b v1.0.
- Adds performance profiles (latency/throughput) for seq lengths 128/512/1024 across our GPU families.
- Wires model onboarding events into the changelog-generator so new models produce draft release notes automatically.
- Adds unit/integration tests for changelog generation and metadata validation.
- Updates registry onboarding script to validate perf profile schema.

Checklist: 
- [x] Metadata JSON added and validated against schema
- [x] Perf profiles added and sanity-checked with perf-canary baseline runs
- [x] Changelog automation updated and tested locally
- [x] Tests added and CI green
- [x] Documentation snippet added to model-registry README

Notes: 
- Perf numbers are derived from internal canary runs (see perf_ci run id in CI checks). Absolute numbers may vary across hardware; recommended runtime mappings are included in metadata.
- Changelog automation will create a draft release note entry under /changelogs/drafts/ when the registry webhook receives onboarding events; ops will review prior to publishing.

Follow-ups (future PRs): 
- Add quantization/accuracy eval entries to metadata after the next eval-harness pass.
- Add example quickstart in redwood-quickstarts demonstrating calypso-mini-2b usage.
